title: Numbers up to 100
seo_title: Numbers up to 100 – Primary 1 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Count, read and write numbers up to 100; find numbers before, after and between; use a hundred square. (summary of the NERDC Primary 1 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free Primary 1 maths worksheets on numbers up to 100: counting on, what comes next, numbers before and after, the hundred square and number stories. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Count on from any number: 47, 48, 49, 50.
  • After 9 units, the tens go up: 39, 40.
  • On a hundred square, each row is 10 more than the row above.

Examples

Example

What comes after 59?

9 units, then a new ten

Answer: 60

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Saying twenty-tenAfter 29 comes 30.
Writing 13 for 31Thirty-one is 3 tens and 1 unit.
Skipping numbersSay every number.

items.q: Count on: 14, 15, 16, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: Count on by 1s. After 16 comes 17. 71 has the digits the wrong way.

items.q: Count on: 23, 24, 25, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: Count on by 1s. After 25 comes 26. 27 skips a number.

items.q: Count on: 28, ☐, 30. What number is missing?
items.e: The missing number comes after 28 and before 30. After 28 comes 29.

items.q: Count back: 86, 85, 84, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: Counting back, each number is 1 less. 84 − 1 = 83.

items.q: Count on: 46, 47, 48, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: After 48 comes 49. Only the units digit goes up by 1.

items.q: Each tick is 1 more. What number goes at the ?
items.e: Count on from 43: 44, 45, 46. Do not count the first tick.

items.q: What number comes just before 40?
items.e: Count back 1 from 40: 39. 41 comes just after 40.

items.q: Count on: 38, 39, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: After 39 comes 40. 9 units and 1 more make a new ten. So 3 tens become 4 tens. Do not write 310.

items.q: Count back: 63, 62, 61, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: Counting back, each number is 1 less. 61 − 1 = 60. 59 skips a number.

items.q: Which number is “twelve”?
items.e: Twelve is 1 ten and 2 units. Write 12.

items.q: How do you say 14?
items.e: 14 is 1 ten and 4 units. Say fourteen. Forty is 40.

items.q: Which number is “sixteen”?
items.e: Sixteen is 1 ten and 6 units. The 1 comes first: 16. 61 is sixty-one.

items.q: Which number is “thirty”?
items.e: Thirty is 3 tens and 0 units. Write 30. 13 is thirteen.

items.q: How do you say 50?
items.e: 50 is 5 tens and 0 units. Say fifty. Fifteen is 15.

items.q: Which number is “nineteen”?
items.e: Nineteen is 1 ten and 9 units. Write 19. 91 is ninety-one.

items.q: Which number is “forty-two”?
items.e: Forty-two is 4 tens and 2 units. Write 42, not 402.

items.q: How do you say 61?
items.e: 61 is 6 tens and 1 unit. Say sixty-one. Sixteen is 16.

items.q: Which number is “fifty-eight”?
items.e: Fifty-eight is 5 tens and 8 units. Write 58, not 508.

items.q: Which number is “seventy-three”?
items.e: Seventy-three is 7 tens and 3 units. Write 73.

items.q: Which number is “ninety-nine”?
items.e: Ninety-nine is 9 tens and 9 units. Write 99, not 909.

items.q: Which number is “one hundred”?
items.e: One hundred is 10 tens. Write 100: a 1 and two zeros.

items.q: Which number is the same as 10 tens?
Write nineteen in figures.
items.e: Nineteen = 19.

items.q: Write twenty-two in figures.
items.e: Twenty-two = 22.

items.q: Write twenty-three in figures.
items.e: Twenty-three = 23.

items.e: Eighty-four = 84.

items.e: Forty-two = 42.

items.q: Write eighty-three in figures.
items.e: Eighty-three = 83.

items.q: Which row has the most counters?
items.e: Count each row: A has 4, B has 6, C has 3, D has 8. Row D has 8. That is the most.
Count each row: A has 7, B has 5, C has 9, D has 6. Row B has 5. That is the fewest.

items.q: Which number is the arrow pointing to?
items.e: Find 5. Count the small marks to the right: 6, 7. The arrow is at 7.

items.q: Which row has 7 balls?
items.e: Count each row: A has 12, B has 9, C has 11, D has 7. Row D has 7. It is equal to 7.

items.q: Which number is the arrow pointing to?
items.e: Find 5. Count the small marks to the left: 4. The arrow is at 4.

items.q: Which row has the most apples?
items.e: Count each row: A has 9, B has 10, C has 12, D has 8. Row C has 12. That is the most.

items.q: Which number is the arrow pointing to?
items.e: Find 15. Count the small marks to the left: 14, 13. The arrow is at 13.
Count each row: A has 8, B has 10, C has 6, D has 9. Row B has 10. It is equal to 10.

items.q: Which row has the fewest counters?
items.e: Count each row: A has 11, B has 13, C has 15, D has 14. Row A has 11. That is the fewest.

items.q: Which number is the arrow pointing to?
items.e: Find 15. Count the small marks to the right: 16, 17, 18. The arrow is at 18.
Count each row: A has 14, B has 11, C has 12, D has 13. Row A has 14. That is the most.

items.q: Which row has the fewest balls?
items.e: Count each row: A has 14, B has 15, C has 12, D has 13. Row C has 12. That is the fewest.

items.q: Which number is more than 36?
items.e: Look at the tens first. 41 has 4 tens. 36 has 3 tens. So 41 is more. 29 has 9 units, but only 2 tens.

items.q: Which number is less than 52?
items.e: Look at the tens first. 25 has 2 tens. 52 has 5 tens. So 25 is less. 52 is equal, not less.

items.q: Which is true?
items.e: 14 is 1 ten and 4 units. 41 is 4 tens and 1 unit. So 14 is less than 41.

items.q: Which number is the greatest: 38, 83, 47, 74?
items.e: Look at the tens. 83 has 8 tens. That is the most tens. 83 is the greatest.

items.q: Which number is the least: 45, 54, 40, 50?
items.e: 45 and 40 have the fewest tens: 4 tens. 40 has 0 units. 40 is the least.

items.q: Ifeoma has 12 sweets. Tunde has 9. Esther has 15. Nkechi has 11. Who has the fewest?
items.e: 9 is the smallest number. Tunde has the fewest sweets.

items.q: Which number is more than 69 and less than 72?
items.e: Count on from 69: 70, 71, 72. 70 is more than 69 and less than 72. 72 is not less than 72.

items.q: Ibrahim has 12 sweets. Usman has 9. Bola has 15. Abdullahi has 11. Who has the fewest?
items.e: 9 is the smallest number. Usman has the fewest sweets.

items.q: Ifeanyi counted 97, 98, 99. What number comes next?
items.e: After 99 comes 100. 10 tens make one hundred.

items.q: Parking spots are in order. A red car is in spot 59. A blue car is in the next spot. What is the blue car’s spot?
items.e: After 59 comes 60. 9 units and 1 more make a new ten.
